In my opinion, there should be at least two staff members assigned to each room so that if one needs to step out, another person can immediately take charge, especially considering the rates owners are being charged. On another occasion, I witnessed the large-dog room being left unattended for over 30 minutes; during that time, a dog had an accident and approximately 10 minutes later actually ate it, and still no staff member had come in to clean up or intervene. I wish I had recorded that incident so the owner could see what happened. I would really like an explanation from management as to why dogs are being left unsupervised for these extended periods and what policies are in place to ensure their safety and proper care.
